'let him to' appears in SkELL only in non-standard lines, so no commonMistake is claimed. Present tense after 'when' is standard time-clause grammar. verifiedNote: author: 2026-10-22. Longman rather GRAMMAR: 'You say that you would rather do something: I would rather play than study. Don't say: I would rather to play than study' (commonMistake evidence); Cambridge rather; SkELL 'would rather' = 40 lines. noteTr: Türkçe '-e girmek' yönelme ekiyle gelir; İngilizcede enter doğrudan nesne alır. Bağlama göre go into / get into de kabul edilir ama enter into başka anlam taşır (anlaşma, görüşme başlatmak).

You borrow something from somebody else, while they lend it to you' (commonMistake evidence); Longman lend ('lend somebody something … Can you lend me £10') and borrow ('Do not confuse borrow and lend'); Cambridge lend; SkELL 'lend me' = 40 lines, 'borrow me' = 4 non-standard lines. patternSlots: The film was ___, so I was ___.
clozeTemplate: The film was ___, so I was ___.
situationTr: [Arkadaşına mesaj] Dünkü filmi anlatıyorsun: "Film çok sıkıcıydı, bu yüzden ben sıkıldım."
acceptedAnswers: The film was boring, so I was bored.

checklistTr: Şey için -ing (boring), kişinin hissi için -ed (bored) mi?
Özne film mi, ben mi? Ona göre sıfatı seçtin mi?
Her iki boşluk farklı sıfat mı?
noteTr: Türkçede 'sıkıcı' ve 'sıkıldım' ayrı sözcüklerdir; İngilizcede aynı kökten -ing (neden) ve -ed (hisseden kişi) gelir. Bağlama göre film yerine movie da kullanılır.
verifiedNote: author: 2026-10-22. Cambridge bored ('tired and uninterested… It was a cold, wet day and the children were bored') and boring (making you feel bored); Longman bored: word family 'bored / boring'; Oxford bored/boring; SkELL 'I was bored' and 'boring' = 40 lines each. No commonMistake: no source labels the swap wrong (only the definitions). Sources: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bored ; https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/bored ; https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/bored ; https://skell.sketchengine.eu/api/concordance?lang=English&query=I+was+bored
